dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, light-intensity 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters defining dark-centered interiors. The outer boundaries exhibit sharp pixel-intensity transitions from light-grey borders to dark-brown/black cores, particularly concentrated on the mid-to-posterior lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid, high-intensity light pixel clusters, appearing as localized nodes at the intersections of the macro-annuli borders.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-lateral annuli form an irregular obtuse triangle; additional centroids on the posterior flank form a series of interconnected polygons with varying internal angles.

other_distinctive_markers: Abrupt transition from high-contrast reticulated patterning on the posterior two-thirds of the subject to a relatively homogeneous, low-contrast dark-pigmented region on the anterior third.
